ns2:course.label: Freshman Materials Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Team-based laboratory developing concepts introduced in MSE 182. Practical descriptions of materials concepts, literature research, experimental design, concept validation, teamwork, and presentation of results. Prerequisite: MSE 182.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Civil Engineering or Computer Engineering or Computer Science or Electrical Engineering or Engineering Mechanics or Engineering Physics or Industrial Engineering or Materials Science & Engr or Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering or Bioengineering or Agricultural & Biological Engr or Aerospace Engineering or Nuclear, Plasma, Radiolgc Engr or Engineering Undeclared or Systems Engineering and Design or Pre-Engineering major(s).
